acceptance.invocation: L9 reading of GRADING_RULE.md and LEGACY_SERVED_PATHS.json at this commit, against LN-h-1's and LN-h-2's gradings of the N6 sample and LN-h-3's comparison
acceptance.output_evidence: RECORDED, NO VERDICT. Material for the grader. EXACTNESS: every step is ordered (G1, G2, G3, grammar, G6) and the first step that decides decides; the verdict is computed by comparing the name with its canonical form (G6 V-2..V-5), so a grader never chooses between verdicts, only builds the form. VOCABULARIES are closed and cited (V1-V8). Where the inputs do not decide, the rule says so instead of guessing: 14 system-slot tokens RAISE (V2, row W1-S2), AWS-fixed names RAISE (G2, row W1-S4), and a slot the name does not carry is a placeholder that forces OUT-OF-PATTERN (V-2, row W1-S3). KNOWN SOFT SPOTS a hand grader may hit: the camel split of an acronym run (N2), and function-vs-qualifier (R5, stated as graded the same). The 43 worked cases trace each verdict to the rule lines applied.
acceptance.denominator: 1 judgment criterion recorded for L9; 43 worked cases and 4 rows offered as material
acceptance.status_reason: judgment criterion (judgment="true"): graded by 3.0.0_SA_CVO at L9 with LN-h-1 and LN-h-2 as the test, never self-graded; this row records the material and carries no verdict.
